content: Jinja2 3.1.6 (2025-03-05). Environment accepts block/variable/comment start/end strings, trim_blocks, lstrip_blocks, keep_trailing_newline, finalize (callable applied to every variable expression result before output), undefined=StrictUndefined (raises on print/iteration/comparison). LaTeX convention \BLOCK{}/\VAR{}/\#{} verified working locally with syrupy snapshot. autoescape is HTML-only; LaTeX escaping must be done via finalize or an explicit filter.
